requirements.claim: Project specification SYN-SPEC-A clause 3.1 limits the lateral deflection of any mullion under the serviceability wind action to span/250 and to 15 mm absolute, whichever is smaller, and states that this requirement takes precedence over the general code limit.
applicability_conditions: Applies to the Terminal Q project because SYN-SPEC-A Rev C is the governing project specification stated in the question context.

requirements.claim: The general framing serviceability limit in SSGC:2024 clause 5.2 is span/175 and 19 mm absolute, whichever is smaller, with span/250 for members supporting a corner or movement joint.

verification_procedure.action: Establish the mullion span between structural supports and compute the serviceability wind action on the mullion.

Check that the computed lateral deflection does not exceed span/250 and does not exceed 15 mm absolute, applying the more onerous project limit from SYN-SPEC-A clause 3.1 rather than the SSGC:2024 clause 5.2 value.

missing_information: The serviceability wind pressure for the Terminal Q location is not in the supplied evidence and must be taken from the project loading documents.

conflicts.description: SSGC:2024 clause 5.2 (span/175, 19 mm) and SYN-SPEC-A clause 3.1 (span/250, 15 mm) give different limits; SYN-SPEC-A clause 3.1 states it takes precedence, so the project value governs.
